name: BackDoorManipulation
summary: Sets up or inspects state by going around the system under test, so that a fixture is reached without exercising what is being tested.

roles.name: BackDoorManipulation
roles.summary: The participant that reaches past the SUT — straight into the database, the file, the queue. It is often the only practical way to arrange a state, and it is always a second definition of the data's shape: when the SUT's own writing changes, the back door keeps working and keeps being wrong.
